react_result.final_narrative_text: Three independent pathway-enrichment paradigms converge on eicosanoid synthesis / arachidonic acid metabolism as the dominant signal in this differential metabolome. RaMP multi-database ORA returns Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) as its top hit with an FDR of 6.18e-14 and a fold-enrichment of 1429, driven by arachidonic acid (KEGG:C00219), leukotriene A4 (KEGG:C00909), 5-HETE (KEGG:C04805), 15-HETE (KEGG:C04742), and 15-deoxy-d-12,14-PGJ2 (KEGG:C14717). The mummichog m/z-direct network analysis independently recovers the same biological module as its #1 hit (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism, p=0.001, 11/11 compounds overlapped), and MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA assigns KEGG:hsa00590 (Arachidonic acid metabolism) rank 1 among its KEGG-only hits (p=0.0051, 4 metabolites hit). The LOX branch is specifically implicated: 5-HETE is the direct 5-lipoxygenase product of arachidonate, and 15-HETE signals the 15-lipoxygenase branch; both are elevated in the treatment group. Leukotriene A4 (C00909) is the unstable epoxide intermediate of the leukotriene pathway, and its presence alongside 15-deoxy-PGJ2 (C14717) — a PPAR-γ ligand — indicates concurrent activation of pro-inflammatory (LOX/COX) and resolution-phase (PPAR-γ) lipid signalling. A secondary signal in methionine and cysteine metabolism is confirmed across two paradigms: MetaboAnalystR hits KEGG:hsa00670 (p=0.0051) and KEGG:hsa00270 (p=0.0082), and mummichog recovers MUMM:methionine_and_cysteine_metabolism (p=0.053). L-cysteine (C00097) and L-cystathionine (C02291) are the driver compounds, consistent with altered transsulfuration flux. Mercaptopurine (C02380) is not captured by any enrichment method — it is a singlet orphan relative to the curated reference networks.

react_result.final_narrative_text: Three pathway-enrichment paradigms converge on arachidonic-acid-derived lipid mediators as the dominant signal. RaMP multi-database ORA identifies Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) as its top hit with FDR 6.18e-14 and five overlapping metabolites (arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 15-deoxy-delta-12,14-PGJ2, 5-HETE, 15-HETE). The Selenium micronutrient network (WP:WP15) shares the same FDR and additionally captures L-cysteine and L-cystathionine, confirming sulfur-amino-acid input into the eicosanoid hub. MetaboAnalystR KEGG-specific PSEA recovers arachidonic acid metabolism (KEGG:hsa00590) as its top hit with four overlapping compounds (arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 15-HETE, 5-HETE) alongside cysteine/cystathionine hits in the cysteine-and-methionine metabolism pathway (KEGG:hsa00670, p=0.0051). Mummichog m/z-direct network analysis independently returns MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism as its top hit (p=0.000756) with 11 overlapping metabolites, confirming the same biological module through mass-feature matching. The Leukotriene metabolism submodule (MUMM:leukotriene_metabolism) and Prostaglandin formation from arachidonate (MUMM:prostaglandin_formation_from_arachidonate) are independently recovered. Arachidonic acid (KEGG:C00219) is the shared substrate linking all three paradigms, with 5-HETE (KEGG:C04805) and 15-HETE (KEGG:C04742) as the dominant 5- and 15-lipoxygenase products driving the enrichment signal. Mercaptopurine (KEGG:C02380) is not captured by any method, indicating a pharmacologic perturbation that does not intersect the lipid-mediator cascade under the detection thresholds used.

final_react_result.final_narrative_text: Three pathway-enrichment paradigms converge on arachidonic-acid-derived lipid mediators as the dominant signal. RaMP multi-database ORA identifies Eicosanoid synthesis (WP:WP167) as its top hit with FDR 6.18e-14 and five overlapping metabolites (arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 15-deoxy-delta-12,14-PGJ2, 5-HETE, 15-HETE). The Selenium micronutrient network (WP:WP15) shares the same FDR and additionally captures L-cysteine and L-cystathionine, confirming sulfur-amino-acid input into the eicosanoid hub. MetaboAnalystR KEGG-specific PSEA recovers arachidonic acid metabolism (KEGG:hsa00590) as its top hit with four overlapping compounds (arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 15-HETE, 5-HETE) alongside cysteine/cystathionine hits in the cysteine-and-methionine metabolism pathway (KEGG:hsa00670, p=0.0051). Mummichog m/z-direct network analysis independently returns MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism as its top hit (p=0.000756) with 11 overlapping metabolites, confirming the same biological module through mass-feature matching. The Leukotriene metabolism submodule (MUMM:leukotriene_metabolism) and Prostaglandin formation from arachidonate (MUMM:prostaglandin_formation_from_arachidonate) are independently recovered. Arachidonic acid (KEGG:C00219) is the shared substrate linking all three paradigms, with 5-HETE (KEGG:C04805) and 15-HETE (KEGG:C04742) as the dominant 5- and 15-lipoxygenase products driving the enrichment signal. Mercaptopurine (KEGG:C02380) is not captured by any method, indicating a pharmacologic perturbation that does not intersect the lipid-mediator cascade under the detection thresholds used.
